description: This file defines the 'SavingsAccount' entity class used in a banking or financial application, representing a savings account with properties, behaviors, and interest calculation methods.

classes.name: SavingsAccount
classes.description: Entity class modeling a savings account with properties such as account number, status, interest calculation parameters, transaction history, and methods for interest posting, deposit, and balance recalculations.

methods.name: createNewApplicationForSubmittal
methods.description: Static factory method to initialize a new savings account application for submission with provided parameters.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Method to perform deposit transactions into the account, including validation and transaction creation.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Posts accrued interest to the savings account up to the specified date, handling interest calculations and transaction updates.

methods.name: calculateInterestUsing
methods.description: Calculates interest over specified periods based on account parameters and interest rules.

methods.name: recalculateDailyBalances
methods.description: Recomputes the daily balances of the account transactions, adjusting running balances and overdraft amounts.

methods.name: getEffectiveInterestRateAsFraction
methods.description: Returns the effective interest rate as a fractional BigDecimal for calculation purposes.

methods.name: findLastTransaction
methods.description: Finds the last non-reversed transaction for a specific date.

methods.name: findInterestPostingTransactionFor
methods.description: Finds an interest posting transaction for a given date.

methods.name: findInterestPostingSavingsTransactionWithPivotConfig
methods.description: Finds an interest posting transaction considering pivot configurations.

methods.name: createWithHoldTransaction
methods.description: Creates a withhold tax transaction based on tax group and amount for interest payments.

methods.name: updateWithHoldTransaction
methods.description: Updates existing withhold transactions to reflect changes in tax calculations.
